notes: New colors, same AdTrapper. The phone gains the Settings screen the computer builds have: a clean white panel with a soft color per door -- Check for updates light blue, Update threat list mint, How it works cream, Disclaimer lavender, Removal history rose. The front wears the same family: the big SCAN button in light blue, the threat-list pill in mint, How it works in cream, Check for updates in light blue and Settings in lavender, all with dark bold words. Nothing else moves: same verdicts, same Carrier Shield protection, same threat list. Tap Check for updates to get it.
